description: This script imports seed data from a JSON file into the database, creating users, courses, and lessons as specified in the input JSON.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, with attributes like email, name, role, and password hash.

classes.name: Course
classes.description: Represents a course with attributes like title and description.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: Represents a lesson within a course, identified by course_id and containing attributes like title and video URL.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function that performs the import of seed data from the specified JSON file into the database.
